title: ligustrum ibota subvar. spathulatum
intro: Ligustrum ibota subvar. spathulatum, commonly known as Chinese Privet, is a plant species within the Oleaceae family, known for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Ligustrum ibota subvar. spathulatum include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and enhancing immune function. The therapeutic actions of the plant include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects, which contribute to its use in traditional Chinese medicine. The bioactive constituents of Ligustrum ibota subvar. spathulatum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its various health-promoting properties.
